name: Clen 4-pin locking connector
notes: Clen calls it "Canon Head Insertion"; it looks like an M12 A-coded 4-pin connector (RES-017, the maintainer's private notes). Its pin map is not measured; Clen's XLR adapter gives pin 1 GND, pin 2 nc, pin 3 data, pin 4 vcc at the XLR end (RES-018).

pins.src: stated by the maintainer: 4 pins on both types (INV-001, the maintainer's private notes)

rated_a.src: assumed from M12's 4 A because the connector looks M12 (RES-017, RES-033, the maintainer's private notes); M12 rating per RES-033: https://www.automationdirect.com/pn/7000-12701-0000000
